rules: You resolve the space you land on. Spaces you pass do not fire, except Payday.
Payday adds your current salary when you land on it or pass it.
A stop ends the move even if steps remain. Then you spin again.
Ages 18 to 21 are a fork. Study and Work each have four spaces, then one shared track from 22 to 68.
At 68 the working track ends. Retirement choices are not in this version.
sources: College Board, Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid 2025. Public four-year in-state student budget $30,990 in 2025-26 ($123,960 over four years). Net cost of attendance $21,340 a year. https://research.collegeboard.org/media/pdf/Trends-in-College-Pricing-and-Student-Aid-2025-final.pdf
College Board, Trends in Student Aid: 2023-24 bachelor's recipients who borrowed left with $29,560 on average. https://research.collegeboard.org/trends/student-aid/highlights
NACE Summer 2026 Salary Survey: Class of 2025 bachelor's average starting salary $67,983. https://www.naceweb.org/job-market/compensation/starting-salaries-climb-for-the-class-of-2025
BLS, employment and wages by typical entry-level education, median annual wage 2025 for high school diploma or equivalent: $48,050. https://www.bls.gov/emp/tables/education-summary.htm

BLS OEWS May 2025: construction trades workers median $58,150; electricians $63,190; electrician helpers about $42,661 ($20.51 an hour). https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm

NAR median existing-home price $417,500 in September 2026. 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers: first-time buyer median down payment 10 percent, July 2024 through June 2025. https://www.nar.realtor/press-releases/first-time-home-buyer-share-falls-to-historic-low-of-21-median-age-rises-to-40

spaces.title: Tuition
spaces.detail: Four years of a public in-state budget, due up front. The number is the price, not the average loan.
spaces.adapts: College path opening. Four years of the published public in-state student budget. No gendered campus.

spaces.title: Long nights
spaces.detail: Labs, a shift, sleep, in that order. Nothing in the account moves.
spaces.adapts: College path year with no payday. Career would already be earning.

spaces.title: Internship
spaces.detail: A paid summer. Enough for food and a bus pass. Not enough to touch the debt.
spaces.adapts: Late college income, smaller than a career payday.

spaces.title: First role
spaces.detail: You stop. School is over, and the higher pay starts with this job.
spaces.adapts: Job Search stop. Guaranteed, like the classic red space. Higher pay than the work path.

spaces.title: First job
spaces.detail: You start work now. No degree required. The pay starts today.
spaces.adapts: Career path opening. Immediate job at the high-school-occupation median. No degree gate.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your pay. The study path does not have this year.
spaces.adapts: Early Payday the career path reaches sooner.

spaces.title: Tools and transit
spaces.detail: Boots, a phone plan, and the bus. The job does not hand you those.
spaces.adapts: Early career expense.

spaces.title: Early raise
spaces.detail: A step toward trade-scale pay, only if you land here. Passing through skips it.
spaces.adapts: From high-school-occupation pay toward the construction-trades median. Land only. Not a stop.

spaces.title: A room of your own
spaces.detail: A lease and a deposit. The first month is due before the key.
spaces.adapts: First household setup after the paths merge.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: A friend's bill
spaces.detail: Their payment app is short. You cover the share.
spaces.adapts: Life-tile style good deed, settled in cash for this solo board.

spaces.title: Tax refund
spaces.detail: The tax app drops a refund you did not plan on.
spaces.adapts: Small windfall.

spaces.title: Partnership
spaces.detail: You stop. Two people, one household. The party is small and still costs.
spaces.adapts: Get Married stop. No spouse gender, no pink or blue pegs.

spaces.title: Household gifts
spaces.detail: People send what they can. Cash, and a pile of kitchen stuff.
spaces.adapts: Honeymoon beat, recast as gifts to the household.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: A child arrives
spaces.detail: A child joins the household. The spare room is no longer spare, and the bills start.
spaces.adapts: Baby space. No boy or girl.

spaces.title: A course
spaces.detail: Nights, a fee, and a raise if you finish.
spaces.adapts: Night school. Optional, like a blue space.

choice.prompt: Pay $4,000 for a course that raises your pay by $4,000?

spaces.title: Car repair
spaces.detail: The car dies in the rain. The shop wants the card.
spaces.adapts: Classic mishap expense.

spaces.title: Year-end bonus
spaces.detail: The year pays a little extra.
spaces.adapts: Bonus windfall.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: A home
spaces.detail: You stop. This is the down payment, ten percent, not the whole price.
spaces.adapts: Buy a House stop. A first-time down payment, not the full sale price and not a deed deck.

spaces.title: Housewarming
spaces.detail: People fill the rooms once, then leave cash for a chair.
spaces.adapts: After the house, a small return.

spaces.title: Twins arrive
spaces.detail: Two children join the household at once.
spaces.adapts: Twins space. No sexes assigned.

spaces.title: A quiet year
spaces.detail: Work, meals, the same walk home. The ledger rests.
spaces.adapts: Breathing room between events. Stands in for a blank orange space.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: Taxes due
spaces.detail: The bill is impersonal and exact.
spaces.adapts: Taxes Due. Paid to the bank in this solo version.

spaces.title: Promotion
spaces.detail: More of the work, and more pay, if you land here.
spaces.adapts: Midlife raise. Land only.

spaces.title: Reunion
spaces.detail: A long table. You pay for the room.
spaces.adapts: Family gathering without assigning who is whose.

spaces.title: The market
spaces.detail: A tip, a stake, and an outcome fixed by the seed.
spaces.adapts: Stock space. Optional. Outcome is seeded, not a hidden shuffle.

choice.prompt: Put $10,000 in the market? Even odds, from the seed. Success pays $24,000 back, a $14,000 gain. Otherwise the $10,000 is lost.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: Sell some gear
spaces.detail: Something you kept finds a buyer.
spaces.adapts: Art or collectible sale.

spaces.title: Clinic bill
spaces.detail: An ordinary bill. No one is removed from the board.
spaces.adapts: Medical expense. Not mortality. That system is later.

spaces.title: Another city
spaces.detail: The work would pay more somewhere else. Moving is not free.
spaces.adapts: Optional life change, in the spirit of a blue space.

choice.prompt: Spend $8,000 to move for a $6,000 raise?

spaces.title: Lost phone
spaces.detail: The phone is gone. The account takes a hit before the bank stops the card.
spaces.adapts: Small mishap. A lost phone, in place of a lost wallet.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: Lesson fees
spaces.detail: Classes for the household. Music, sport, whatever they asked for.
spaces.adapts: Child-related cost without boy/girl framing.

spaces.title: Ordinary weeks
spaces.detail: The same keys, the same hour. Nothing to post.
spaces.adapts: Quiet year.

spaces.title: Pay adjustment
spaces.detail: A cost-of-living raise, if this is the year you land.
spaces.adapts: Small raise. Land only.

spaces.title: A side venture
spaces.detail: Nights and a stake. The seed already knows how it ends.
spaces.adapts: Risky business. Optional. Seeded odds.

choice.prompt: Stake $10,000 on a side venture? A 3-in-5 chance, from the seed, pays $24,000 back, a $14,000 gain. Otherwise the $10,000 is lost.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: Storm damage
spaces.detail: Water where water should not be. The deductible is yours.
spaces.adapts: Home damage expense.

spaces.title: Recognition
spaces.detail: The work is seen. Pay moves, if you land here.
spaces.adapts: Late-career raise. Land only.

spaces.title: A quiet year
spaces.detail: No headline. The household keeps its shape.
spaces.adapts: Quiet year.

spaces.title: Unexpected gift
spaces.detail: Money from someone who kept their word. No name, no portrait.
spaces.adapts: Inheritance windfall, gender-neutral.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday. Collect salary on land or pass.

spaces.title: Support a parent
spaces.detail: A parent needs a year of help. You send it.
spaces.adapts: Family support. No mother/father assignment.

spaces.title: Neighborhood festival
spaces.detail: Lights over the street. You pay for the table.
spaces.adapts: Community life-tile flavor, as a small cost.

spaces.title: A quiet year
spaces.detail: The board is still. So is the account.
spaces.adapts: Quiet year.

spaces.title: Contract bonus
spaces.detail: A job closes. The bonus clears.
spaces.adapts: Late windfall.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary.
spaces.adapts: Payday near the classic early-retirement age. No early retirement choice in this version.

spaces.title: A medical year
spaces.detail: Appointments, a bill, and you are still on the track.
spaces.adapts: Health cost. Not a death sliver.

spaces.title: A quiet year
spaces.detail: Morning, work, evening. Mark the year and go on.
spaces.adapts: Quiet year.

spaces.title: A farewell
spaces.detail: A colleague leaves. You chip in for the send-off.
spaces.adapts: Workplace life event.

spaces.title: Payday
spaces.detail: Collect your salary. One year of the track remains.
spaces.adapts: Last Payday before the gate.

spaces.title: Retirement gate
spaces.detail: You stop. Working life ends at 68. This version ends with it.
spaces.adapts: Retire stop. No Millionaire Estates, no annuity, no decumulation.
